title: Slack Code Turns Coding Agents Into Team Collaborators
summary: Slack’s new shared coding channels expose agent work, previews and code changes to entire teams instead of individual users.
body:
## Coding agents enter the shared workspace

Salesforce has launched Slack Code, a collaboration layer that lets teams direct coding agents and review their work without leaving Slack. When someone tags a supported agent in a conversation, Slack can create a dedicated Code Channel containing the task discussion, the agent’s working context and its generated artifacts.

Those artifacts can include proposed code changes, before-and-after diffs, repository links and a functioning preview presented in a Slack canvas. Product managers, designers and other stakeholders can comment while the work is still taking shape, rather than waiting for an engineer to return from a private terminal session with a completed implementation.

Salesforce’s launch page names Anthropic’s Claude, Cognition’s Devin, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT and Vercel’s agents as founding Slack Code partners. That launch roster is not identical to the current availability list: Slack’s help documentation currently identifies Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot and Vercel as approved agents that can create Code Channels, while Slack’s launch coverage says OpenAI’s ChatGPT integration is coming soon. These Slack Code lists should also not be conflated with Slack’s broader marketplace of AI applications. Slack Code is available on any Slack plan, but access to the selected partner agent is required separately. Salesforce plans to open the Code Channel interfaces to a broader developer community so additional custom agents can participate.

## A bid for control of the agent workspace

The launch extends existing integrations that already let individual agents accept assignments from Slack. Its more consequential change is the creation of a vendor-neutral, persistent record around the work: prompts, decisions, revisions and generated code remain visible in the same channels where the team defined the problem.

That visibility may reduce costly rework when an agent follows an interpretation that technically satisfies a prompt but conflicts with product intent. It also introduces governance questions. Companies will need clear permissions around which repositories, conversations and deployment systems each agent can reach, as well as responsibility for approving generated changes.

The broader significance is strategic. Coding-model providers are competing to own the developer’s terminal, while Salesforce is positioning Slack as the coordination layer above all of them. If that approach succeeds, the lasting enterprise asset will not merely be the code an agent produces, but the shared organizational context explaining why it was produced.
title_zh: Slack Code让编程智能体进入团队协作频道
summary_zh: Slack推出共享编程频道，让整个团队都能查看智能体的执行过程、代码改动和运行预览，而不再局限于个人会话。
body_zh:
## 编程智能体走进共享工作区

Salesforce推出Slack Code，允许团队直接在Slack中向编程智能体分派任务并共同审查结果。成员在讨论中提及受支持的智能体后，Slack可创建专用的Code Channel，将需求对话、智能体所用上下文及其生成成果集中在一处。

频道内可展示代码修改前后的差异、代码仓库链接以及可运行的预览，并通过Slack画布供团队审阅。产品经理、设计师及其他相关人员因此能在方案成形期间就参与反馈，而不必等工程师结束一段封闭的终端会话后，再面对已经完成的实现。

Salesforce的发布页面将Anthropic的Claude、Cognition的Devin、GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT和Vercel的智能体列为Slack Code创始合作方。不过，这份发布名单并不等同于当前可用名单：Slack帮助文档目前列出的可创建Code Channel的获批智能体为Claude、Devin、GitHub Copilot和Vercel；Slack发布内容则说明OpenAI的ChatGPT接入仍将于稍后推出。这些Slack Code名单也不应与Slack应用市场中更广泛的AI应用名单混为一谈。Slack Code可在所有Slack套餐中使用，但客户仍须单独获得所选合作智能体的使用权限。Salesforce还计划向更广泛的开发者群体开放Code Channel接口，让更多自定义智能体参与其中。

## Slack争夺智能体协作入口

过去已有智能体能够从Slack接收任务；此次更新更重要的变化，是为整个开发过程提供了跨厂商、可持续留存的协作记录。提示词、产品决策、修改意见与生成代码，都能保存在最初讨论问题的频道中。

这种透明度有望减少返工：智能体即使在技术上完成了提示词，也可能误解产品意图，团队如今可以更早纠偏。不过，企业也需要重新划定权限，明确各个智能体能够访问哪些代码仓库、对话和部署系统，以及最终由谁批准生成的改动。

这项发布的重要性还在于平台竞争。各家模型公司正在争夺开发者终端，而Salesforce希望让Slack成为凌驾于不同智能体之上的协调层。若这一模式得到采用，企业真正沉淀的资产将不只是智能体写出的代码，还包括解释这些代码为何产生的共享组织上下文。
